description: Candidate on v2 kinematics: evidence-audited strength, explicit uncertainty, independently fixed PD. Not a certified population model.

CDC2011.cohort: Healthy ages 20-44; arithmetic mean of published female and male ROM means; not a pooled population mean.

MORIN2023.cohort: 30 healthy adults, 17 men/13 women, 21-69 y, mean 41.3 y, mean mass 71.8 kg; convenience sample.

DANNESKIOLD2009.cohort: Youngest group 20-29 y, 18 women/10 men; equal-sex average of isometric means, not isokinetic values.
DANNESKIOLD2009.location: Results: shoulder adduction, trunk, hip adduction, ankle plantarflexion; narrative explicitly specifies Nm

SILDER2007.cohort: 20 healthy young adults, 9 men/11 women, sex-specific mean ages 26.1/25.5 y.
SILDER2007.location: Table 4 mean coefficients and Appendix A; five uniarticular terms plus rectus femoris and hamstrings; gastrocnemius excluded

FORMICA2012.cohort: 10 healthy right-handed adults, 7 men/3 women, mean age 30 y, range 24-42 y.
FORMICA2012.location: Table 2 total means, radial/ulnar deviation and pronation/supination stiffness

NGUYEN2020.cohort: 25-45 y stratum, 37 women/41 men; equal-sex mean. Relaxed wrist, small oscillations +/-10 degrees, 3-12 Hz.
NGUYEN2020.location: Table 2: female/male flexion 89.89/85.29 deg, extension 68.27/68.19 deg; EL 1.64/2.22 Nm/rad; VI 1.89/2.56 Nms/rad

KOYKKA2025.cohort: 35 physically active adults, 20 men/15 women, age 30 +/-7 y; non-dominant means applied bilaterally.
KOYKKA2025.location: Table 2: mean of test/retest, pronation 8.68/8.88 Nm; supination 9.77/9.79 Nm

NIEWIADOMSKI2019.cohort: 97 no current neck pain volunteers, mean age 28.3 y; some past neck pain.
NIEWIADOMSKI2019.location: Abstract, after outlier exclusions: total flexion-extension 127.4 deg, lateral inclinations 89.3 deg, rotations 146.4 deg. Symmetric split and equal Neck/Head allocation are assumptions.

ASSUMPTION.location: Engineering approximation, NOT a measured healthy adult mean. See README assumptions.

UNMEASURED.location: No defensible coefficient selected: zero central stiffness/damping is omission, not evidence of zero tissue resistance.

PROXY.location: Borrowed measured torque from another direction/DOF; not a measured mean for this DOF. See joint note.

KANEDA2020_CANDIDATE.cohort: 17 men, control pre; two-parameter population calibration, not independent validation
KANEDA2020_CANDIDATE.location: Table 2 knee passive torque; coupled ratio retained from Silder basis

NGUYEN2020_POPULATION.cohort: 81 women aged 18-45, 1.68m; disjoint age strata pooled by n
NGUYEN2020_POPULATION.location: Table 2 EL/VI; runtime damping converted from Hz slope by 2*pi

TOE2025_POPULATION_PROXY.cohort: 9 participants, effective anglewise n3-6, two visits averaged per person
TOE2025_POPULATION_PROXY.location: Dataset1 passive hallux+lesser torque, lumped-axis proxy, positive zero-rest spring fit

ANDERSON2007_DYNAMIC.scope: Bilateral hip flexion/extension, knee flexion/extension, ankle plantar/dorsiflexion only. Source dynamometer coordinates transferred to oblique joint coordinates as a proxy. Out-of-domain boundary hold is unvalidated.

PAN2025_V3.location: Results: weight-normalized isometric medians, sex-average multiplied by 63.31kg; bilateral direction averages
PAN2025_V3.scope: Seated aggregate trunk; serial thoracolumbar transfer remains an assumption

VASAVADA2001_V3.location: C7 male/female mean: extension52/21 flexion30/15 lateral36/16 axial15/6 Nm
VASAVADA2001_V3.scope: Equal-sex average, identical serial moment proxy; no posture curve validated

DELP1996_V3.location: Peak radial11.0, ulnar9.5 Nm; task-specific isometric sample

force_calibration_origin: v1 population candidate: Kaneda knee, Nguyen wrist damping, pooled toe stiffness; same-cohort calibration, not independent validation
transfer_scope: Upper body v1; lower force laws transferred as proxies to fixed anatomical axes, not independently calibrated.

active_strength_model.location: Eq.9, Table2 and Table3, ages18-25, seven men and seven women
active_strength_model.interpretation: Equal mean of two sex-specific prediction curves using each cohort mean mass and height. This is a synthetic cohort proxy, not personalization of the SMPL mass and not held-out biological validation. No Anderson passive term is added.
active_strength_model.outside_domain: Hold angle and angular speed at nearest reported measurement-domain boundary; report outside-domain fraction. This guard is an assumption, not validated extrapolation.
active_strength_model.status: candidate; default v2 sagittal force law
active_strength_model.scope: Bilateral hip flexion/extension, knee flexion/extension, ankle plantar/dorsiflexion only. Source dynamometer coordinates transferred to oblique joint coordinates as a proxy. Out-of-domain boundary hold is unvalidated.

strength_basis.population: Healthy adult mixed-sex reference, not a measured individual or normative percentile
strength_basis.gait_data_role: Independent demand validation, NEVER a multiplier used to define MVC
